toegepas.blok: Metaal kan in dun drade getrek word
toegepas.rede_vinder: Two coordinate adjectives before a noun (lank en dun) are separated by a comma under the AWS.
toegepas.fout: Two coordinate adjectives (lank en dun) before the noun are not separated by a comma, as the AWS requires.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Adding the comma between coordinate adjectives is an AWS punctuation fix that changes nothing in the meaning and touches no protected wording.

na_skrywer.voor: Wanneer 'n vaste stof warm word en in 'n vloeistof verander.
na_skrywer.na: Om van 'n vaste stof in 'n vloeistof te verander wanneer dit warm word.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: A verb's definition should not open with 'Wanneer' (an English 'is when' construction); the 'Om ... te' form defines the verb itself with the same meaning.
na_skrywer.fout: The definition of the verb 'smelt' opens with 'Wanneer', an English 'is when' construction, instead of defining the action itself.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but this is a glossary definition shared across lessons and the rewording goes beyond a plain spelling or grammar fix, so only the writer may change it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Sterk wanneer jy trek of druk
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'aanmekaar' already says joined; 'vas' after it is redundant.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'aanmekaar vasslaan' is a normal, natural Afrikaans combination, so cutting 'vas' is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Uit daardie klip haal hulle die metaal self uit.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Daarna haal hulle die metaal self uit daardie klip.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The double 'uit ... uit' is clumsy; the plain order reads more easily and 'daarna' only makes the existing sequence explicit.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Uit daardie klip haal hulle ... uit' is natural Afrikaans, and the proposal adds 'daarna', which is new content.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: wanneer hulle sê metaal word gemyn
laat_vaar_vorige.na: wanneer hulle sê dat metaal gemyn word
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Reported speech with 'dat' and verb-final order is clearer and more standard.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Reported speech without 'dat' is natural Afrikaans, so adding it is a lateral move.
